classes.label: eg-pr-hero
classes.css: padding-top: clamp(8rem, 13vw, 10.5rem); padding-bottom: 0;

classes.label: eg-pr-volver
classes.css: margin: 0 0 2.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem;

classes.label: eg-pr-cab
classes.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.8fr); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 3rem; align-items: end; padding: 0; @media(--tablet) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }

classes.label: eg-pr-titulo
classes.css: font-size: clamp(2.375rem, 5vw, 4.25rem); line-height: 1.04; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: var(--eg-papel);

classes.label: eg-pr-media
classes.css: position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 8; margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem); border-radius: 1.5rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; @media(--mobile) { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 1rem; }

classes.label: eg-pr-cuerpo-sec
classes.css: padding-top: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);

classes.label: eg-pr-datos
classes.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0; @media(--tablet) { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }

classes.label: eg-pr-chip
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1.125rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--eg-linea); background-color: var(--eg-niebla);

classes.label: eg-pr-chip-valor
classes.css: font-family: var(--eg-sora); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--eg-tinta);

classes.label: eg-pr-cuerpo
classes.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 17rem minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 6rem); align-items: start; margin-top: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); padding: 0; @media(--tablet) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

classes.label: eg-pr-ficha
classes.css: position: sticky; inset-block-start: 7rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding: 0; @media(--tablet) { position: static; }

classes.label: eg-pr-fila
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.875rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--eg-linea);

classes.label: eg-pr-valor
classes.css: font-family: var(--eg-sora); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--eg-tinta);

classes.label: eg-pr-boton
classes.css: margin-top: 1.75rem; align-self: flex-start;

classes.label: eg-prosa
classes.css: display: block; padding: 0; min-width: 0; max-width: 46rem;

classes.label: eg-pr-nav-sec
classes.css: padding-top: 2.5rem; padding-bottom: 2.5rem;

classes.label: eg-pr-nav
classes.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 1rem; padding: 0; @media(--mobile) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

classes.label: eg-pr-kicker
classes.css: display: block;

classes.label: eg-pr-adyacente
classes.css: display: block;

classes.label: eg-pr-siguiente
classes.css: display: block;
